Trident stateful-fuzzing follow-up to the 2026-07-31 scan (see prior entry), per memory/topics/veilo-bug-hunt-playbook.md. Full local toolchain stood up (rustup 1.97.1, Solana CLI 2.3.0, Anchor 0.32.1 via avm, Trident CLI 0.12.0 — playbook listed 0.11.1, 0.12.0 is current) and the program built clean (target/deploy/privacy_pool.so, 1,798,768 B vs. AUDIT.md's deployed 1,808,464 B — expected non-reproducible-build delta, not a discrepancy signal). SCOPING FINDING (the actual headline result): every fund-moving instruction (transact, reissue, positions, swap, ephemeral_*) is gated by a Groth16 proof check (verify_transaction_groth16) that runs BEFORE any state mutation, and AUDIT.md confirms the Circom circuits / proving key / trusted-setup transcript are intentionally not in this repo. No valid proof can be forged locally, so Trident (or any fuzzer) cannot get past that gate to reach the nullifier/merkle/vault logic — the exact surface the playbook flagged as fuzzing's highest-value target (step 6, adversarial instruction sequencing manual review can't reach). This is a hard ceiling on this target, not a harness-writing gap. Fuzzed instead the reachable non-proof-gated admin/setup surface (initialize_global_config, initialize, add_merkle_tree, add_relayer, remove_relayer, update_pool_config) with a hand-written Trident flow harness (trident-tests/fuzz_0/test_fuzz.rs, not the auto-generated skeleton) asserting ground-truth invariants per-call (attacker-key-must-fail on every authority-gated instruction, add_merkle_tree tree_id must equal cfg.num_trees exactly, re-initialize must always fail). Ran 1000 iterations x ~100 flow calls (~100k instruction invocations): 0 panics, 0 assertion/invariant failures across add_merkle_tree (20170 invoked), add_relayer (19844), remove_relayer (19752), update_pool_config (20093), reinitialize_attempt (20141, 100% correctly rejected). Confirms AUDIT.md's stated admin-authority invariants hold under adversarial sequencing on this surface. Toolchain notes for reruns: host rustc 1.97.1 promotes `deref_nullptr` to a hard error on the MerkleTreeAccount offset-of test (anchor build's local IDL-build step only — not the audited on-chain logic); rewriting that test to `core::mem::offset_of!` fixes it without touching program semantics. `trident fuzz run` must be invoked from trident-tests/ (Trident.toml root-discovery walks up from CWD, not down).
